999008199.text: 勝手に家探しするみたいで悪い気がするけど……

localizations.en: I feel bad about going through someone's house like this...

999008199.text:
でも誰かが住んでたのが信じらんないほど
人の居た気配がないわよね

localizations.en: But it's hard to imagine that anybody actually lived here from the state it is in.

999008199.text: そうね。これ見て、新品のドレスだわ

localizations.en: Right. Look at this—it's a brand-new dress.

999008199.text:
他には何もないみたいだし、住んでいた形跡もない。
どういうことなんだろう？

localizations.en: There's nothing else here, and no real signs anyone was living here. What's going on?

999008199.text: でも、こんなものも見つけたよ

これ、お姫様の日記みたいだよ！
やっぱりお姫様はここに居たんだよ

localizations.en: It looks like a princess's diary! So there really was a princess here!

999008199.text:
なんらかの事情があって、日記と新品のドレスだけを
残して姿を消したのかな

localizations.en: Maybe something happened and she disappeared, leaving only her diary and this new dress behind.

999008199.text: だけどそれじゃ、状況を変えられないわよ

localizations.en: But if that's the case, how will we be able to progress?

999008199.text:
やっぱり狼の魔物を狩りに行っちゃう？
とりあえず村の人たちが外へ行けるようにはなるわよ

localizations.en: Should we just go hunt those wolf monsters? At least then the villagers would be able to leave.

999008199.text:
待って。物語を進めるために
誰かがお姫様の役をするっていうのはどうかな？

localizations.en: Wait. What if someone plays the role of the princess to advance the story?

999008199.text:
家にドレス、日記……舞台が揃っているこの状況で
物語を進めるために必要なのは、あとお姫様だけだから

localizations.en: We have the house, the dress, the diary... The stage is all set. All we need to move the story forward is a princess.

999008199.text:
こーいうのは度胸よ！
物語を進めれば、村人は村から立ち去れるんだから

localizations.en: We can at least try! If we did manage to advance the story, the villagers should be able to leave the village safely.

999008199.text:
少なくとも、閉じ込められた人たちが
解放される道はあるってことだもんね

localizations.en: That would give us a path to free the people who are trapped here.

999008199.text:
姫役が危ない目に遭わないように、
みんなで気を付ければいいんだものね

localizations.en: As long as we all watch out to make sure whoever plays the princess doesn't get hurt.

999008199.text: そうと決まったら、誰が姫役をやるか決めましょ

localizations.en: Now that we've decided, let's figure out who's going to play the princess.

999008199.text: ふぇぇ。に、似合ってる？

localizations.en: Eep. D-does it look good on me?

999008199.text: バッチリですよ、ロロナ先生！　かわいいっ！

localizations.en: Perfect, Miss Rorona! You look so cute!

999008199.text: ロロナ先輩、素敵ですよ
えへへ、ありがと……
で、でも、わたしがお姫様役でいいのかな？

localizations.en: B-but are you sure I should be the one playing the princess?

999008199.text:
いーの。ロロナちゃんが一番このドレスの大きさに
ぴったりだったんだから

localizations.en: Of course! The dress fits you better than anyone else.

999008199.text: えへへ。こんなドレス着てみたかったんだぁ

localizations.en: Ehehe. I've always wanted to try on a dress like this!

999008199.text: ったく、気楽なものね

localizations.en: Geez, you're pretty carefree about this.

999008199.text: ひゃぁっ！
ロロナ先生が、狼の魔物に！

localizations.en: Miss Rorona's been taken by the wolf monsters!

999008199.text: 本の通りに……なっちゃった
私があんな提案をしたから……

localizations.en: This is all my fault for suggesting this plan...

999008199.text: 考えてても仕方ないわ。ロロナを追うわよ！

localizations.en: There's no point dwelling on it now. Let's go after Rorona!

999008199.text: はいっ！
わあああ～～～！？　どこに連れていくの～！？

localizations.en: Waaahhh! Where are you taking me?!
